messages.content: How many work days do I have left this year?

Here's what I found:

**France work hour limit (⚠️ VERIFY)**
The figure in our knowledge base is approximately **964 hours per year** for non-EU students (roughly 60% of the French legal full-time annual hours, or about 20 hours/week on average). However, **this entry has not been confirmed against a current official source**, so please double-check it with:
- [Campus France](https://www.campusfrance.org)
- Your **préfecture**
- Your university's **International Office**

**Your quota usage**
No work days have been logged for you in France yet this year, so I can't calculate how many hours you have remaining until you start tracking your shifts.

**To get an accurate picture:**
1. ✅ Verify the exact hour limit with an official source (see above).
2. 📋 Start logging your worked shifts — just tell me something like *"I worked 5 hours today"* and I'll record it automatically in the background.

Once you've logged some shifts, I can tell you exactly how many hours you have left for the year!
